title: 第二十一章 王妈博彩第三弹下第二十二章 佳话
content_zh:
陆宁也看向她，笑了笑，说：“好啊，王妈，还是以三十万贯为彩头，你要赌什么？”
打量着王氏，心说这就是小周后的乳母啊，现今童稚年龄的小周后，不知道是什么样子。
隐隐的，不由有些期待，历史上关于小周后的传说太多太多了，便是自己，也不能免俗，很想见见她呢。
嗯，应该，还是个乳臭未干的小丫头片子……
王氏自不知道，称呼少了一个字，陆宁却是等于一竿子将她打入了小保姆行列，还以为是本地的尊称呢。
不过，她脸上微有愠意，凝视陆宁，“东海公，赌之前，妾想问你，我王家与你何仇何怨？你赢尽我胞兄家财不说，又将我族子弟王缪抄家问罪，判以极刑！是我那胞兄王吉，哪里得罪你了吗？！”
陆宁摇摇头：“东海政务，不需向你个小女子交代，至于王吉，嗯，你就当我喜欢赌，是个滥赌鬼吧，谁叫那王吉也滥赌呢？”
李景爻和郑续，相视苦笑，这东海公的行事风格啊，真是别具一格，怎么就一点敬畏之心都没有呢？好像全天下，也没值得他认真对待的人，所以，说话才这么随意吧？
王氏脸上微微变色，压抑着怒气，微微颔首，“既如此，那妾就与东海公赌上一赌，东海公，还是照旧么？谁和你对赌，谁出题目？”
“可以呀！”陆宁摊摊手。
“好，东海公，第一个题目，我就赌你，不知道自己有多少根头发！”王氏凝视陆宁，一字字说。
李景爻呆了呆，暗挑大拇指，这司徒府出来的，真的是不一般，一个题目比一个题目刁钻，这次这题目，怕东海公，不能解答了吧？
说是对赌，实际上，这桩公案，渐渐变成，就是司徒府一方，出各种题目，看东海公能不能化解。
陆宁也怔了下，随即笑道：“王妈这题目，很是犀利，不过，如果王妈赢了，下一个题目，会不会是赌，看我陆宁能不能飞翔于九天？”
王氏轻轻摇头：“妾虽然妇道人家，但东海公也忒看轻妾，妾出的题目，自己自然是能解的，妾就知道自己，有多少根头发！当然，这个题目，倒也不必一定极为精确，东海公说出的数目，和你头发数目，上下不超过五十数，便算你赢。对妾，也是如此。”
在场诸人，又都是一呆。
便是杨刺史，此时也不由暗中挑大拇指。
不消说，这王氏做足了功课，想象得到，她肯定来了海州几日了，而这几日，已经令婢女们将自己有多少根头发数的清清楚楚，甚至这几天的落发断发，都在计数之内，说起来容易，做起来就太难太难了。
而且，这王氏也极为谨慎，所以，上下加了五十根的容错量。
“东海公，如果你认输，我就暂时不赌了，容我几日，再想一个题目。”

一次三十万贯，她要赢两次才行。
王氏显然没想到陆宁这次会用三十万贯为限额，所以，她要赢两次，才能将王吉输的三十万和周贡输的三十万都赢回来，而她原本，仅仅准备了一个题目。
她倒也光明磊落，坦坦荡荡承认需要时间再想一个题目，不过，正因为大气坦白，才更难应付。
陆宁笑了笑，说：“王妈就不必再费心准备新题目了，因为这场赌博，我感觉你会输呢，我的头发，有九万两千一百五十六根！”
被雷劈了后，陆宁的感官极为敏锐，有一次，却是无聊对着略模糊的铜镜数起了自己的头发有多少根，就是看自己的目力，能精准到什么程度。
尔后，这都成了他的锻炼项目了，就昨天晚上，还搬来几个铜镜在前后左右，自己数来着，而从就寝到现在，新陈代谢极慢的他，一根落发也没有。
被雷劈来到这个世界，新陈代谢好似都变得极为缓慢，陆宁有时胡思乱想，不会几十年后，自己还是这体格这容貌吧？
听陆宁的话，在场众人又都是一呆。
这，这东海公，这也行吗？难道还真有这么无聊的人，没事叫来一帮婢女，数自己有多少根头发？
“东海公莫说笑，浪费公和诸位大人的时间。”王氏显然不相信陆宁的话。
陆宁笑道：“本公并不是说笑，你大可叫人来数数，看我说的数目对还是不对？！”
王氏微微蹙眉，随即，便轻轻拍掌，“来人！”
content_en:
Lu Ning also looked at her, smiled, and said, "Okay, Queen Mother, let's take 300,000 yuan as the lottery prize. What do you want to bet on?"
Looking at Mrs. Wang, I thought to myself that this is Xiao Zhouhou's wet nurse. I don't know what Xiao Zhouhou looks like at the childish age.
Faintly, I can't help but look forward to it. There are too many legends about Xiao Zhouhou in history. Even I am not exempt from the vulgarity. I really want to meet her.
Well, probably, she is still a young girl...
Wang didn't know that the title was missing one word, but Lu Ning had immediately entered her into the ranks of nannies, thinking it was a local honorific.
However, there was a hint of sullenness on her face, and she stared at Lu Ning, "Donghai Gong, before we bet, I want to ask you, what grudge does my Wang family have against you? You won all my brother's family's wealth, but you also ransacked my family's family, Wang Miu, and sentenced him to death! It's my brother Wang Ji, did you offend me in any way?!"
Lu Ning shook his head: "There is no need to explain the government affairs of the East China Sea to you, a little girl. As for Wang Ji, well, just think that I like to gamble and am an abusive gambler. Who told Wang Ji to gamble excessively?"
Li Jingyao and Zheng Xu looked at each other and smiled bitterly. Donghai Gong's behavior was really unique. Why didn't he have any awe at all? It seems that there is no one in the world who deserves to be taken seriously by him, so that's why he talks so casually, right?
Wang's face changed color slightly, she suppressed her anger, and nodded slightly, "In that case, I will make a bet with Donghai Gong. Donghai Gong, is it still the same? Who will bet with you, and who will raise the question?"
"Okay!" Lu Ning spread his hands.
"Okay, Mr. Donghai, for the first question, I bet you that you don't know how many hairs you have!" Wang stared at Lu Ning and said every word.
Li Jingyao was stunned and secretly raised his thumb. This person from Situ Mansion is really unusual. Each question is more tricky than the last. I am afraid that Donghai Gong won't be able to answer this question this time, right?
It was said to be a bet, but in fact, this public case gradually turned into a case where the Situ Mansion raised various issues to see if Donghai Gong could resolve it.
Lu Ning was also startled for a moment, then smiled and said: "Wang Ma's question is very sharp, but if Wang Ma wins, will the next question be a bet to see if I, Lu Ning, can fly in the sky?"
Wang shook her head gently: "Although I am a good woman, Duke Donghai also looks down on me. Naturally, I can solve the questions I ask. I know how many hairs I have! Of course, this question does not have to be extremely accurate. If the number mentioned by Duke Donghai and the number of your hairs are not more than fifty, you will win. The same is true for concubine."
Everyone present was stunned again.
Even Governor Yang couldn't help but secretly give a thumbs up at this time.
Needless to say, Mrs. Wang has done enough homework. It is conceivable that she must have been in Haizhou for a few days. In these few days, the maids have clearly counted how many hairs they have. Even the hair loss and breakage in the past few days are included in the count. It is easy to say, but too difficult to do.
Moreover, the Wang family was extremely cautious, so they added fifty ounces of error tolerance.
"Donghai Gong, if you admit defeat, I will stop gambling for the time being. Give me a few days to think of another topic."
Three hundred thousand dollars at a time, she has to win twice.
Wang obviously did not expect that Lu Ning would use 300,000 yuan as the limit this time, so she had to win twice to win back the 300,000 yuan that Wang Ji lost and the 300,000 yuan that Zhou Gong lost. However, she originally prepared only one question.
She was also aboveboard, admitting frankly that she needed time to think about another topic. However, it was precisely because of her openness that it was more difficult to deal with it.
Lu Ning smiled and said, "Mother Wang, you don't have to worry about preparing new questions anymore, because I think you will lose in this gamble. I have ninety-two thousand one hundred and fifty-six hairs!"
After being struck by lightning, Lu Ning's senses were extremely sharp. Once, it was...Boredom counted the number of hairs on his head in front of the slightly blurry bronze mirror, just to see how accurate his eyesight could be.
Since then, this has become his exercise program. Just last night, he moved several bronze mirrors around and counted them by himself. However, since going to bed until now, he has an extremely slow metabolism and has not lost a single hair.
After being struck by lightning and coming into this world, his metabolism seemed to have become extremely slow. Lu Ning sometimes thought wildly, wouldn't he still have the same physique and appearance in a few decades?
After hearing Lu Ning's words, everyone present was stunned again.
This, this Donghai Gong, is this also okay? Is there really such a boring person who would call a bunch of maids to count the hairs on his head?
"Mr. Donghai, please stop joking and wasting your time and your lords' time." Wang obviously didn't believe what Lu Ning said.
Lu Ning smiled and said: "I am not joking. You can ask someone to count and see if the number I said is correct or not?!"
Wang frowned slightly, then clapped her hands gently, "Come here!"
